'''Laser welders''' or '''welding lasers''' were tools carried in [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] and also by [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]].

[[P2-series astromech droid]]s were equipped with laser welders which helped them to effect simple repair jobs.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
